title: Nintendo Switch 2 Sells Over 26 Million Units
content:
Total Switch 2 software sales amount to 73.21 million units as of September 30, with 24.49 million from this fiscal year so far. Digital game sales accounted for 60.7% of total software sales this year so far for Switch and Switch 2, a 6.2% year-on-year increase.

The Switch console has sold 1.27 million units so far this fiscal year as of June 30. This number includes sales for the Nintendo Switch, Lite, and OLED consoles. Switch software sales amount to 65.73 million units. Regarding Nintendo 's last couple of first-party titles developed for the original Switch console, Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream sold 8.81 million units, and Rhythm Heaven Groove sold 2.89 million units.

The bestselling titles for Switch 2 as of September 30 are:

• Mario Kart World: 16.48 million copies

• Donkey Kong Bananza: 5.05 million copies

• Pokémon Legends: Z-A – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition: 4.04 million copies (13.31 million with Switch version)

• Pokémon Pokopia: 4.04 million copies (only includes sales outside Japan where Nintendo published game)

• Splatoon Raiders: 2.42 million copies

• Kirby Air Riders: 1.94 million copies

• Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave: 1.34 million copies

• Super Mario Party Jamboree – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition: 1.28 million copies (12.01 million with Switch version)

• Star Fox: 1.17 million copies

The bestselling titles for Switch as of September 30 are:

• Mario Kart 8 Deluxe: 72.00 million copies

• Animal Crossing: New Horizons: 50.63 million copies

• Super Smash Bros. Ultimate: 38.50 million copies

• The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild: 34.28 million copies

• Super Mario Odyssey: 31.06 million copies

• Pokémon Scarlet/Pokémon Violet: 28.66 million copies

• Pokémon Sword/Pokémon Shield: 27.36 million copies

• The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom: 22.90 million copies

• Super Mario Party: 21.39 million copies

• New Super Mario Bros. U Deluxe: 19.22 million copies

The Switch 2 console sold over 3.5 million units worldwide in the first four days following its release in June 2025. According to the company, this is the highest global sales amount for any Nintendo hardware within its first four days. The system sold 5.82 million units in its first fiscal year's first quarter ending in June 2025. Switch 2 sold over 17 million units as of the end of the previous fiscal year's third quarter on December 31, surpassing the Nintendo Wii U's lifetime sales of 13.56 million units.

Nintendo raised suggested retail prices for Switch 2 on May 25 in Japan. It raised the prices in Europe, the United States, and Canada on September 1 "in light of changes in market conditions, and after considering the global business outlook."

Nintendo launched the Switch console in March 2017. The Switch surpassed Sony 's PlayStation 4 and Nintendo 's Game Boy/Game Boy Color as of the end of 2022. The console surpassed the Nintendo DS' lifetime sales of 154.02 million units to become Nintendo 's best selling console of all time last February It is now the second best-selling console of all time, and stands behind only PlayStation 2.
author: ANN

title: I'm Kodama Kawashiri Manga Gets Live-Action Short Series
content:
Kodama Kawajiri 's Atasha Kawajiri Kodama Da Yo: Dangerous Life Hacker no Tadareta Seikatsu manga is getting a live-action short series. The series will have 25 episodes. Hulu will exclusively stream five short episodes on Mondays starting on January 11 at 6:00 a.m. JST. Each set of five episodes will then air once a day on NTV 's morning television show ZIP! that week. Two exclusive episodes will also launch on Hulu on Fridays. Kanna Hashimoto stars as Kodama.

Yūichi Fukuda is directing and writing the live-action series.

I'M KODAMA KAWASHIRI , the anime adaptation, premiered in January 2022 within the EXITV~FOD no Shinsaku Meisaku wo Pon! Pon! Misemakuri!!~ variety program on Fuji TV . Crunchyroll streamed the anime.

Aoi Yūki plays not only the main character Kodama, but "almost every other role."

The essay manga depicts the lazy, unhealthy daily life of Kawajiri, who loves alcohol and anything greasy, salty, or sweet.

Kawajiri's manga debuted on Twitter in 2020, and his account has since garnered over 425,000 followers. Kadokawa published the manga's third compiled book volume in January 2024.

title: Eternal Palace Sakura Game Launches for Switch, PC
content:
Shochiku confirmed on Thursday that it has released Denneko Yuugi's Eternal Palace Sakura game for Nintendo Switch and PC via Steam on Wednesday. The company streamed a launch trailer:

Shochiku describes the 3D action roguelite game:

Step into the dreamscape of the Eternal Palace. You are Retla, a cat-eared dual-weapon-wielder, tasked with navigating an ever changing labyrinth that challenges every adventurer who dares enter. Each run is a test of skill, cunning, and courage.

A demo is available on PC via Steam .

title: Godzilla Minus Zero Reveals Official Look at Film’s Secret Kaiju, And It’s Amazing
content:
The rumors turned out to be true, and we finally know for a fact that the King of Monsters will not be alone in Godzilla Minus Zero . For months, kaiju fans have been teased with the possibility of Godzilla’s arch-nemesis being a part of Takashi Yamazaki’s sequel to his 2023 blockbuster, and now we can say it from the top of our lungs – King Ghidorah is back, and he is looking more dangerous than ever. The big question that remains is how does this fearsome three-headed monster fit into the world established by this very grounded version of Godzilla.

The latest trailer for Godzilla Minus Zero dropped earlier today, which also includes a bevy of positive critical reviews on top of additional plot details revealed through the 60-second video. While the crux of the movie is that Godzilla has returned to devastate Japan once again despite his defeat at the end of the previous movie, it seems something else has come with him this time that will flip this movie upside down… or in Godzilla’s case, drop him on his back from a thousand feet up in the air. This could have big implications for the current state of the franchise, but there’s another piece of news that can’t be ignored that could potentially make this exciting reveal more on the bittersweet side.

King Ghidorah Is On The Rampage in Godzilla Minus Zero

King Ghidorah is only seen for two shots that barely total two seconds of screen time in the new trailer, but it’s still plenty to show what a destructive force of nature this kaiju is — and that’s saying something considering how much more lethal Godzilla was shown to be in Godzilla Minus One . From what we can glean from the short trailer, Ghidorah is presumed to be dropping Godzilla from a great height, revealing its three heads by blasting the screen with a trio of lightning bolts. We get a closer look at those terrifying faces deeper in the trailer, which resemble a cross between a Tyrannosaurus Rex and a dragon of ancient lore.

This is a game changer for the Godzilla Minus franchise, potentially opening up this world to more encounters with other famous Toho monsters. Many of these beings have largely been ignored by the Japanese studio over the past decade, while the American Legendary series has stuffed as many kaiju as possible into their sequels (including a rumored Space Godzilla to be appearing in the next entry). With over 70 years of history and a massive roster of giant monsters to pull from, it feels like the right time for Toho to capitalize on the resurgence of this monster mash.

Unfortunately, many signs are pointing to this sequel being the conclusion of this particular era . Previous trailers have blatantly told audiences “There is no third time. Everything ends here” by literally spelling it out during the video. Many believed this was meant to close the franchise, but Yamazaki recently told Japan Forward that if Toho asked for another, he would be open to the idea, officially commenting, “Please don’t rule out the possibility.” Toho has announced plans for an expanded monster universe of their own that may include many standalone features, but if the Godzilla Minus series can keep moving forward and tell the growing story of the Shikishima family, audiences would be more than happy to watch Godzilla raid again.

King Ghidorah’s first appearance was in the self-titled movie from 1964, Ghidorah, the Three-Headed Monster , which was a turning point for the budding franchise. The fifth movie in the series, this was the first film that began Godzilla’s babyface turn by reluctantly allying with Mothra and Rodan to take down this new threat. His defeat didn’t last long, returning one year later in Invasion of the Astro-Monster, and returning sporadically throughout the Shōwa era movies to keep all of the kaiju on their toes. Throughout all subsequent eras of Godzilla, King Ghidorah has remained the biggest thorn in Godzilla’s side, always returning to wreak havoc against humanity while being a massive problem for every kaiju around the planet. His involvement in the latest film appears to be as an antagonist once again, but is he man-made, from outer space, or something entirely different? Audiences will find out the answer this weekend when the movie officially roars into theaters.

Are you excited about this sequel now that you know Ghidorah is officially a part of the movie, or are you still disappointed that this could be the end for this part of the franchise? Let us know in the comments.

title: Crunchyhroll to Stream Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Anime's English Dub on November 12
content:
Crunchyroll announced on Thursday that it will begin exclusively streaming the English, Spanish, and Portuguese dubs for the Dragon Ball Super: Beerus television anime series on November 12 at 11:00 a.m. EST. New dubbed episodes will premiere weekly. The company streamed an English trailer:

The dub casts (featuring returning members) include:

English

• Sean Schemmel as Son Goku

• Christopher R. Sabat as Vegeta

• Jason Douglas as Beerus

• Ian Sinclair as Whis

Spanish

• Mario Castañeda as Son Goku

• René Garcia as Vegeta

• José Luis Orozco as Beerus

• Arturo Castañeda as Whis

Portuguese

• Wendel Bezerra as Son Goku

• Alfredo Rollo as Vegeta

• Marcelo Pissardini as Beerus

• Felipe Griñán as Whis

Crunchyroll is simultaneously streaming the anime in Japanese with English subtitles on October 11 in the United States, Canada, Latin America including Brazil, Australia, New Zealand, South Africa, India, Southeast Asia, and Europe. Hulu is also streaming the anime as it airs. Netflix began streaming the series in the U.S. on October 17, and and October 14 in selected areas/countries.

The first episode also screened in advance at the Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Special Panel at New York Comic Con on October 8.

The staff for the new anime includes:

• Composition and Direction Arrangement: Matsuto Seya

• Animation Character Design & General Animation Director: Tadayoshi Yamamuro

• Editing: Eiichi Nishimura

• Compositing Director: Yōsuke Motoki

• Music: Norihito Sumitomo

The anime again features Kōichi Yamadera as Beerus.

MEGATERA･ZERO performs the opening theme song "ONOGAMI," and VK Blanka performs the ending theme song "Kan Peki No Peki."

Akio Iyoku stated the work started a few years ago and is an "enhanced" edition of the Dragon Ball Super anime that features a reconstruction of the story, and includes new and redrawn cuts.

The official announcement of the anime stated:

The project features extensive new cuts, revisions to existing scenes, a complete re-rendering of all footage, newly recorded dubbing with added score and sound effects, and a full reconstruction of the story. Living up to the name ENHANCED, this edition employs the latest visual expression to deliver greater power and immersion across all scenes, especially the battle sequences. The result is an ENHANCED edition that expresses Akira Toriyama 's original idea and worldbuilding more accurately, that will be broadcasted with highly satisfying quality.

The anime staff stated, "the anime Dragon Ball Super ... is set to begin anew as Dragon Ball Super: Beerus in Fall 2026."

The staff describes the story:

Several years have passed since the fierce battle against Majin Buu, and Earth has finally regained a brief moment of peace. At the same time, Beerus, the God of Destruction, awakens from his long, deep sleep. Even Kai and Supreme Kai, aware of Beerus's overwhelming power to destroy entire planets, watch his awakening with great fear… Meanwhile, Beerus hears rumors of a Saiyan who defeated Frieza—and suddenly appears before Goku.Targeted by Beerus, the strongest being in the universe, Earth is in grave danger. Thus begins an Earth-shattering cosmic battle between the God of Destruction and Goku and his allies—a conflict that will shake the entire universe.

Dragon Ball Super premiered in July 2015 and aired for 131 episodes until March 2018. Funimation and Crunchyroll streamed the series as it aired, and Funimation released the series on home video. Funimation debuted the English dub to its streaming service in December 2016. The English dub premiered on Adult Swim 's Toonami block in January 2017.
author: ANN

title: Titan Manga Licenses Kuruno Loves the Occult!, Dominating at the Academy of Returned Heroes, More Manga
content:
Titan Manga announced on Thursday that it has licensed the following manga for release in summer 2027:

When high-school student Yuuki is contacted online by the mysterious Kuruno, he finds himself dragged into a series of increasingly strange expeditions to investigate the supernatural. From the infamous Kisaragi Station and Chupacabra sightings to cursed houses, haunted locations and mysterious local legends, Kuruno is determined to experience the occult first-hand… even if she has to force Yuuki to come along for the ride.

But beneath her enthusiasm lies a surprising secret: Kuruno is a complete scaredy-cat, relying on Yuuki to find the courage to face the things she loves most. As the pair encounter one bizarre situation after another, their dangerous and often hilarious adventures begin to bring them closer together.

But instead of peace, he finds himself enrolled in an academy for “returned heroes”, a place where strength defines status and every student fights to prove their worth. For most, it's a proving ground. For him, it's already beneath his level.

As rankings are challenged and rivalries ignite, his overwhelming power begins to upend the academy's fragile hierarchy. What was meant to be a system of order quickly spirals into chaos as one student effortlessly surpasses every expectation. Yet beneath the surface, deeper threats and hidden truths begin to emerge, hinting that the world he left behind may not be finished with him.

In this outrageous romantic experiment, thirteen “high-spec” individuals, each a prodigy in their own right, are brought together for a reality show designed to produce the ultimate marriage. Genius scientists, elite strategists, and once-in-a-generation talents must navigate not only romance, but each other's overwhelming egos and impossible expectations.

As alliances form and collapse, every interaction becomes a high-stakes psychological battle. Romance is no longer simple: every confession is calculated, every date a performance, and every rejection a public spectacle. But beneath the absurdity lies a deeper question: can people who excel at everything truly connect on a human level?

Now a single mother working at a supermarket, Ria has never abandoned her love of rock. Determined to form a new band and pursue the music she believes in, she is searching for the right people to join her. Then she encounters Maria, a woman whose voice is exactly what Ria has been looking for.

Their meeting could be the beginning of something special. Both women even share the same “Maria” reading in their names – a strange coincidence that seems to call more Marias into their orbit. Soon, the seeds of a new band are being planted, and Ria's dream of returning to the stage begins to take shape.

After retreating to the countryside in search of a fresh start, a burnt-out creator encounters an eccentric mountain god, an ancient being with a surprising interest in modern manga. What begins as a chance meeting quickly turns into an unusual arrangement: the artist will create stories to entertain the god, in exchange for a place to stay and a chance to rediscover their passion.

As the seasons change, so too does their relationship. Between quiet moments in nature and gentle supernatural encounters, the artist begins to heal from creative exhaustion, finding new meaning in both their work and life. But beneath the calm lies a deeper connection between the human and the divine, one that may change them both forever.

Sourcce: Email correspondence
author: ANN

title: Good Smile Company Partially Reopens on November 6 Following Data Breach of Online Store
content:
The company also revealed that it has restored the online store to its state before the unauthorized access from a backup. It has also repaired vulnerabilities in its administration system and strengthened its procedures in order to prevent recurrence. The company also plans to strengthen its web application firewall against cyberattacks and provide 24 hour monitoring. According to the company, an independent team of security specialists have determined that browsing the website poses no risk of viruses or the possibility of unauthorized customer information being obtained.

Account information, new account registration, new orders, cart additions, and Watchlist functions will remain unavailable until the independent investigation and security measures are complete.

Good Smile Company took the online store down when it discovered the breach on October 23, and is currently investigating the incident. The company claimed that it has since "strengthened system security," and added that it has removed the vulnerability that it identified as the cause for the security breach. The company has also reported the incident to Japan's Personal Information Protection Commission, in accordance with Japanese law.

The company stated that its investigation established that a malicious program was present on the website's credit card payment page from October 21 at 1:55 p.m. JST to October 23 at 7:00 a.m. JST. The information concerning the installation of the malicious program was discovered on October 28 shortly after 6:30 p.m. JST. The company stated that the vulnerability believed to be the cause of the issue is different from the PHP vulnerability.

The company added that 2,800 customers who may have entered their information on the website's credit card payment page during that time may be affected by the issue, and their information such as cardholder's name, complete 16-digit card number, expiration date, and security code may have been exposed. The company stated that it has contacted the affected customers by email separately.

Additionally, the company revealed that customers who have previously registered their credit card information on the website may have their partial information exposed, including the last four digits of the card and expiration date. The company confirmed that cardholders' names or security codes have not been exposed, and no registered member information linked to the exposed partial information was exposed. The company estimated that the number of credit cards that may have partial information exposed is 402,466 excluding duplicates.

The company added that 7,673 customers who placed orders on October 22 between shortly before 10:20 p.m. JST and shortly before 11:00 p.m. JST may have their order information exposed. Information that may have been exposed include: shipping and/or billing name, shipping and/or billing address, shipping and/or billing telephone number, email address, order details, order amount, and payment method. The company stated that information relating to 202 orders was viewed without authorization, but since the website's system does not allow the company to fully identify which order information was viewed, the company considers all customers associated to the 7,673 orders may have been affected.

Good Smile is a video game developer, hobby and toy merchandise manufacturer, anime producer, and online retail company. The company's signature toy lines are the popular Nendoroid and Figma figure lines. Nendoroid figures are small figures of anime, manga, and pop culture characters that are portrayed in a super-deformed style, and may have limited poseability and swappable faces. Figma is an action figure line of anime, manga, and pop culture characters that focuses on high articulation and poseability.

title: Lycoris Recoil: Friends are thieves of time. Anime Short Films Get Manga Adaptation
content:
The six-episode shorts debuted on Aniplex 's official YouTube channel in April 2025. The shorts also streamed on Aniplex USA 's YouTube channel, and on Crunchyroll .

The shorts center on the daily lives of the characters at Café LycoReco.

Bizen launched the Lycoris Recoil manga in Monthly Comic Flapper in September 2022. Kadokawa shipped the ninth compiled book volume on August 21. Yen Press shipped the fifth volume of the manga on June 23.

Asaura 's Lycoris Recoil: Ordinary Days spinoff novel reached over 250,000 copies in circulation in 2022.

Lycoris Recoil premiered in July 2022. Crunchyroll streamed the series as it aired in Japan, and it also streamed an English dub . The anime also aired on Adult Swim 's Toonami block in January 2024.

The television anime was Shingo Adachi 's directorial debut. Before this anime, Adachi was the character designer and chief animation director for Sword Art Online and Wagnaria!! (Working!!). Imigimuru ( This Art Club Has a Problem! ) designed the television anime, and A-1 Pictures produced the project. Ben-To author Asaura drafted the story. Kimika Onai ( Nogizaka46 , Sakurazaka46 outfits) designed the characters' uniforms.

title: The Dangers in My Heart Season 3 Anime's Teaser Trailer Reveals April 2027 Premiere
content:
The official website for the anime of Norio Sakurai 's The Dangers in My Heart ( Boku no Kokoro no Yabai Yatsu ) manga revealed on Friday a teaser promotional video, visual, and April 2027 premiere for the third season .

A compilation film titled The Dangers in My Heart: The Movie opened in Japan on February 13. HIDIVE screened the film in the U.S. on February 16 in Japanese with English subtitles and on February 18 with an English dub . The film has sold more than 170,000 tickets worldwide, including in screenings in the United States, Latin America, France, Germany, Italy, and parts of Asia.

Seven Seas Entertainment licensed the main manga, and it describes the story:

Ichikawa Kyotaro, a boy barely clinging to the bottom rung of his school's social ladder, secretly believes he's the tortured lead in some psychological thriller. He spends his days dreaming up ways to disrupt his classmates' peaceful lives and pining after Anna Yamada, the class idol. But Kyotaro's not nearly the troubled teen he pretends to be...and it turns out Anna's a bit odd herself!

Sakurai launched the manga in Akita Shoten 's Weekly Shōnen Champion magazine in March 2018. The manga moved to Akita Shoten 's Champion Cross manga website in April 2018. When Champion Cross merged with Akita Shoten 's other manga website Champion Tap! to form the new website Manga Cross in July 2018, the manga moved to that new site. The manga ended on September 15. Akita Shoten published the manga's 14th and final compiled book volume shipped on Friday. Seven Seas Entertainment published the manga's 13th volume on August 25.

The manga's light novel adaptation written by Kota Nozomi ( When Supernatural Battles Became Commonplace ) and illustrated by Sakurai and sune shipped in Japan in September 2024.

The manga's Twi-Yaba spinoff manga also has an anime that premiered in December 2023.

Haika Nanasaka launched a manga spinoff titled Boku no Kokoro no Yabai Yatsu Love Comedy ga Hajimaranai ( The Dangers in My Heart : A Romantic Comedy Will Not Start) on the Champion Cross manga website in July 2025.
author: ANN

title: The Dangers in My Heart (BokuYaba) Season 3 New Visual and Trailer Revealed, April 2027 Release
content:
The Dangers in My Heart (BokuYaba) Season 3 revealed a key visual and trailer, along with an April 2027 release date. Studio Shin-Ei is again in charge of the animation production. You can watch the new trailer below.

Also check out the key visual featuring Anna Yamada and Kyotaro Ichikawa:

Norio Sakurai’s The Dangers in My Heart ( BokuYaba ) manga officially ended on September 15, 2026, with its final chapter released on Akita Shoten’s Champion Cross website.

The series began serialization in 2018 in Weekly Shonen Champion before later moving to Champion Cross. It follows Kyotaro Ichikawa, a socially withdrawn middle school student, and Anna Yamada, the popular girl in his class, as they slowly develop a romance despite the completely different personalities.

The manga has over 7 million copies in circulation. The final volume, Volume 14 , releases today on November 6 in Japan. A special edition will also include Kyotaro Ichikawa’s 12th Junior High School Graduation Album Art Book , featuring approximately 200 pages of illustrations.

The first season of the TV anime adaptation ran for 12 episodes in Spring 2023. The second season of the anime ran for a total of 13 episodes in Winter 2024, absolutely dominating our weekly rankings all the way with the first sweep in history. The second season also won the title of 2024 Anime of the Year , along with many other awards.

Seven Seas Entertainment licensed the title in English, while HIDIVE is streaming the anime. The story follows Kyotaro Ichikawa, a boy who fantasizes about acting on his twisted thoughts, but an encounter with the adorable Anna Yamada completely changes his life.

The franchise also released a novel adaptation on September 25, 2025, with the book featuring 4 short stories, along with showing Kyotaro and Anna 10 years in the future.
author: Anime Corner
